author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Tucker Carlson to question a growing concern around modern elections: do voters still have real influence over outcomes? As trust in political systems declines, many people feel that regardless of who is elected, the same patterns continue—raising questions about how much power truly shifts after each cycle. The conversation explores whether deeper structures and incentives shape decisions beyond what’s visible during campaigns.
